project.name: Mandaue study corridor · PASADA / LEAR
project.layout_provenance: Study selection from user-supplied paper p.33; junction details pp.36–38. OSM road paths reviewed against satellite imagery. Lane widths, turn pockets and exact signal / stop-line / cabinet positions need survey.

study_area.title: Mandaue City · three-intersection study corridor
study_area.selection_status: User-designated study area from paper p.33
study_area.scope_note: The manually controlled minor crossing between sites 2 and 3 is a boundary influence, not a fourth modeled signalized site (paper pp.33–34).
study_area.geometry_note: Road alignment is derived from OpenStreetMap, reviewed against imagery. Reported paper distances are not used to stretch coordinates.

architecture.signal_heads: Multiple signal heads share an intersection phase authority; not independent timing controllers

c2c_receiver.role: LoRa telemetry gateway, separate from intersection coordinators

architecture.clock: External RTC retained time; explicit synchronization needed. Monotonic elapsed time for timeouts.

provenance.description: Mandaue geographic planning configuration with synthetic traffic. Not the paper’s calibrated SUMO dataset.
